# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Worker 4 Slot 96: Wwise Tier-1 Contextual Music Director (oe_aud_, 0 DLC dependency, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v120_music_director.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# Single Unified Wwise Tier-1 Playback Wrapper (Risk R2 single-point control)
# Parameters: track = <verified vanilla MusicPlayer_* event>, cue_id = <1..14>
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope (root MUST be the target human player country).
oe_aud_play_track = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_aud_can_play_cue = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud_cue_cd value = 1 months = 6 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud_last_cue_id value = $cue_id$ }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_play_count } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_aud_play_count value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = oe_aud_play_count add = 1 }
		post_audio_event = {
			persistent_object = music_manager
			event = $track$
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Toggle player mute state cleanly between active and silent modes.
oe_aud_toggle_mute = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_aud_muted }
		remove_variable = oe_aud_muted
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud_muted value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Clear the 6-month anti-spam cue cooldown for immediate consecutive auditioning.
oe_aud_clear_cooldown = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_aud_cue_cd }
		remove_variable = oe_aud_cue_cd
	}
}

# Country scope (called from hidden oe_aud.1 where root = human player country).
# Evaluates the 14 contextual cues in priority order; at most one cue fires per cycle.

# ==============================================================================
# Slot 96 Mainline Scheduler Entry Point (gen_mainline_lock.py -> oe_aud_monthly)
# Dispatches hidden oe_aud.1 ONLY onto non-AI, non-rebel countries not muted and not on cd,
# guaranteeing root = human player country (works for ANY playable tag, O(1) in SP).
# ==============================================================================

oe_aud_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { oe_aud_rule_is_off = yes } }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_aud_can_play_cue = yes
			}
			trigger_event_silently = oe_aud.1
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 88 Helpers (oe_aud_dev_*, ZERO debug_log -> CMDLOG = 0)
# ==============================================================================

# Dev Page 88: Open the Jukebox & Audit Readout Console (oe_aud.90).
oe_aud_dev_open_jukebox = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_aud.90
}

# Dev Page 88: Toggle oe_aud_muted and verify oe_aud_play_track skips while muted.
oe_aud_dev_toggle_mute = {
	oe_aud_toggle_mute = yes
}

# Dev Page 88: Clear 6-month oe_aud_cue_cd for consecutive live-test auditions.
oe_aud_dev_clear_cd = {
	oe_aud_clear_cooldown = yes
}

# Dev Page 88: Cycle-audition Cue 1 -> Cue 4 -> Cue 8 -> Cue 11 cleanly one at a time.
oe_aud_dev_fire_epic_cues = {
	oe_aud_clear_cooldown = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_aud_dev_cycle } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud_dev_cycle value = 0 }
	}
	change_variable = { name = oe_aud_dev_cycle add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:oe_aud_dev_cycle ?= 1 }
		oe_aud_play_track = {
			track = MusicPlayer_05_The_Rise_of_an_Empire
			cue_id = 1
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_aud_dev_cycle ?= 2 }
		oe_aud_play_track = {
			track = MusicPlayer_26_Peace_of_Westphalia
			cue_id = 4
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:oe_aud_dev_cycle ?= 3 }
		oe_aud_play_track = {
			track = MusicPlayer_sol_chinese_Ambush_from_Ten_Sides_The_Complete_Epos
			cue_id = 8
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = oe_aud_dev_cycle value = 0 }
		oe_aud_play_track = {
			track = MusicPlayer_21_Conquer_or_Fall
			cue_id = 11
		}
	}
}

# Dev Page 88: Trigger one immediate Slot 96 contextual evaluation pulse.
oe_aud_dev_run_pulse = {
	oe_aud_monthly = yes
}

# Dev Page 88: Rule #18 live overrides (1 = Standard, 2 = Concert Only, 3 = Off, clear = default).
oe_aud_dev_rule_standard = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 1 }
}

oe_aud_dev_rule_concert_only = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 2 }
}

oe_aud_dev_rule_off = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 3 }
}

oe_aud_dev_rule_clear = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v120_rule_override }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v120_rule_override
	}
}
